note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Alaska 34th Legislature 2025-2026 Regular Session (LegiScan 2171). Seats come from LegiScan's `district` field, never its `role` field: `role` says Rep for six sitting senators (Mike Cronk SD-R, Matt Claman SD-H, James Kaufman SD-F, Scott Kawasaki SD-P, Shelley Hughes SD-M, Kelly Merrick SD-L), while `district` is right for all 62. The 23 people in the dataset with a blank district are standing committees filed as sponsors; none of them casts a vote, so they are left out of this file. Six members are mapped: five the proposer matched and one hand-added. Every other entry is null because our Alaska roster is still being filled in - it covers 6 of 40 House districts and 1 of 20 Senate districts today. Extending the roster and re-running the import adds those members without duplicating anything.
